heuristic_selection: Select one fixed heuristic by mean dev net utility before opening test aggregate results.
ppo_selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoint for every seed; no test-based selection.
execution: All policies share the frozen Luna-generated, Luna-interpreted utterance bank. Interpretation errors are charged and preserved, never replaced with intended labels.
oracle: Exact public-belief model planner is an upper benchmark only for canonical language; not presented as an exact optimum for a fallible bank.
hypotheses: Question value depends on rejection cost and reliability after accounting for information from offers.
High deal rates can coexist with unused information and avoidable utility loss.
Faithful utterance realization is separate from selecting a useful strategy.
statistics: Aggregate response branches and language variants within synthetic cases, then contexts within event groups. Three-seed SD measures training variability; only two held-out event groups, so no historical population CI.
human_review: Agent/model annotation is not human gold; prepare a blinded review sheet. Teammate reproduction remains a human task.
stop_rule: Complete fixed run matrix and report all failures; no tuning after test evaluation.

replication.reason: User explicitly requested testing the same setup with GPT-5.6 Sol.
replication.primary_direct: Same 64 cases, prompt and reasoning none as Luna, on the unchanged Luna bank to isolate selector model.
replication.secondary_direct: Sol reasoning medium, same 64 cases on Luna bank; max output including reasoning 4096.
replication.own_bank_direct: Sol reasoning none on Sol bank, same cases. Cache reused only if public prompt exactly matches.
replication.language: 396 Sol generations and 396 Sol interpretations, 180 same probes; no correction of errors.
replication.learning: Replicate all 14 main learned runs and six distillation/fine-tuning checkpoints, same seeds, budgets and dev selection.
replication.evaluation: Same original test for main results; same follow-up 64 numeric settings for improvement. Both are previously exposed, a model replication rather than new blind evidence.
replication.stop: No hyperparameter/prompt tuning to favor Sol or the proposed method. Report contrary results.
replication.budget: Same shared ledger; cumulative internal ceiling $9, user exclusive ceiling $10; no reset.
replication.interpretation: PPO is an established algorithm, but the configured negotiation policy and distillation system are our constructed baselines. Do not claim a general LLM failure from their weaknesses.
